selection_data: three per-subject, per-finger complete-event folds spanning all 400000 development samples; released-test labels excluded
definition: trainable refers to gradient updates of the spatial and spectral front end, not merely to the downstream LSTM

taxonomy.trainable_ica_wavelet: FastICA initializes the spatial projection and bior6.8 initializes the eight-band wavelet tree; the stem is frozen during LSTM warm-up and then fine-tuned
taxonomy.fixed_joint_dictionary: frozen ICA-wavelet energies are concatenated with seven fixed designed-band energies passed through training-fitted own-finger and any-movement CSP; fold-local LARS selects features and a nonlinear LSTM is trained

designed_band_csp.carrier_filter: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth after 60/120/180 Hz notch filtering
designed_band_csp.components_per_contrast: two smallest- and two largest-generalized-eigenvalue filters
designed_band_csp.energy: log1p of L2 amplitude in each nonoverlapping 40 ms bin
designed_band_csp.fit_boundary: CSP, normalization, and LARS are refit inside every development fold

historical_note: Earlier chronological-validation routing used a different mixture of fixed, trainable, CSP, and stacked models; it is documented in the project report and is not represented by this current map.
